video_title: Hornets vs Nets: Coach Charles Lee Postgame Media Availability | 10/6/2026

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Liam McNeely's performance and future development
quotes.excerpt: Liam has had a really good off-season. He's had a really good training camp.
quotes.quote: Liam has had a really good off-season. He's had a really good training camp. You take the totality of his work. Like you said today, he had some good moments, he had some moments he can be better in. The thing that I would like him to focus on, no matter what's going on offensively, how can we still be tight defensively? And I thought that there were just some areas there where there's too much slippage, too many layups or not enough activity to get back on closeouts. And so that's where the focus has got to be, I think defensively, and then also how do I also play team defense because there's shifts and there's crowds and how am I just making that next play. But I know Liam, he's going to keep getting better and I look forward to just watching his growth as the preseason keeps going because he's getting some more opportunities.
quotes.social_post: Hornets coach Charles Lee wants to see more defensive consistency from rookie Liam McNeely. Lee noted there was too much slippage defensively tonight but remains confident in the young forward's continued growth throughout the preseason.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Naz Reid's versatility and playmaking ability
quotes.excerpt: That just shows the versatility we have in Naz, the trust that we have in Naz.
quotes.quote: That just shows the versatility we have in Naz, the trust that we have in Naz to be a good playmaker. Sometimes those mismatch situations are for you to score, but it's also just to create maybe some shifts of the defense and some holes in the defense, collapse the defense around the paint. And so I think he did a really good job of reading situations. There were times there where he sped up and trying to go too fast and not allowing our spacing to correct around him, but those are all things that I think we'll continue to work through. And I'm proud of the group for recognizing where is the mismatch and being able to see that within the plays.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee praised Naz Reid for his playmaking and versatility tonight. Lee noted that while Reid did a good job reading the defense, the team will continue to work on spacing to ensure those mismatch situations are even more effective.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on using preseason for situational lineup experimentation
quotes.excerpt: We practice it and now you get to be able to come out here to the game and do it.
quotes.quote: We practice it and now you get to be able to come out here to the game and do it. And I think it's good for the coaching staff but also good for the players to be mindful of what's going on. Then we can go back and watch it and talk through it and those guys can start to get in a rhythm too to understand what is the situation and why are we doing what we doing.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says the Hornets are using the preseason to focus on situational lineup experimentation. The goal is to get players comfortable with specific scenarios so they can review the tape and build rhythm together.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Michael Ajayi's energetic preseason progress
quotes.excerpt: He's just shown us who he can be, who he is as a defender, guarding multiple positions.
quotes.quote: Really just excited that he was able to earn an opportunity to play tonight. I think that he's just shown us who he can be, who he is as a defender, guarding multiple positions with his size and his length. And I think he'll figure out the physicality part of the game. Coming in and rebounding, I think it's been a really big thing for him as well. And then offensively, just finding his niche, finding where his spots to be able to slash and how can he drive it a little quicker and make quick decisions. But I thought he had some really big offensive rebounds, some extra passes here and there and I know some of those finishes that he missed, I'm confident that we've been watching him all off-season make those. And so really proud of the progress he's making and look forward to just continue to watch it. He's going to have opportunity with the Hornets but also in Greensboro too. The more reps he gets, the better he gets.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee is impressed by Michael Ajayi's defensive versatility and rebounding. Lee confirmed Ajayi will see opportunities with both the Hornets and the Greensboro Swarm this season as he continues to develop his offensive game.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on balancing experimentation with player health in preseason
quotes.excerpt: These are the cards you're dealt right now with some of the injuries.
quotes.quote: These are the cards you're dealt right now with some of the injuries and trying to be mindful of how we're building up certain guys. So there's going to be some moments where you don't want to push the envelope on somebody because they're probably not ready for those extra minutes or whether it was a long stint or something like that. So we're just trying to be mindful as we continue to work through the preseason. So some of it's experimenting, but some of it's also just these are the healthy bodies that we have and we got to find a way to rotate them throughout the game.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee says the Hornets' current rotation is a mix of tactical experimentation and managing player health. Lee noted the team is being careful not to push guys too hard while dealing with current injury limitations.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Hannes's rapid learning and defensive potential
quotes.excerpt: He takes the coaching so quickly and he picks up things really fast.
quotes.quote: He takes the coaching so quickly and he picks up things really fast. The only thing he didn't pick up fast today was that I wanted him to make that after-action a little bit quicker, but he finally got it. And that's who he is and that's who he is and that's like you get to coach him, he wants to be coached, which is really exciting. I think everyone got to see defensively there's still like how to figure out where to be in center field, how to read. We want to continue to push him and his voice and his communication in defensive coverages because he's capable. Like he's got the strength, he's got the foot speed to move laterally, it's just like the communication and how fast can he pick up on all these sets that are happening in the NBA. And then offensively, I think we got to see like he's got a great motor, he's rim running, he's able to seal, he's got really good hands, his touch around the basket, he came up with a couple offensive rebounds or got fouled on the glass too. So really excited about the versatility that Hannes brings.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee is excited about the versatility Hannes brings to the Hornets. Lee highlighted his rapid learning, defensive potential, and rim-running ability, noting that the focus remains on improving his communication in defensive coverages.
